description: This file declares the RemoveSource class, which is a task for removing a media source in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references several external interfaces and context objects.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class representing a task to remove a media source from the player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource task with the given context, client, gstWrapper, and source type.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to remove the media source.
